impact: computeAgreement keys matching on non-null file+line; plan findings have neither, so every plan finding lands in `keyless` → divergent. Live probe (deliberate-deep plan review of an ISS-022 fix plan): 0 agreed / 11 divergent even though both providers independently flagged the same three concerns (mtime granularity, composite-rebuild lifecycle, failure-policy gaps) in near-identical words. The agreed/divergent split — the core value of deliberation for plans — is meaningless for review_plan; every plan deliberation degrades to a cross-review-only signal. Fix needs a plan-specific match key (e.g. normalized-category + text similarity, or provider-side finding topic tags), ideally informed by live two-provider plan data the way T-029 was for code.
title: Plan-review deliberation can never agree: findings without file:line are all routed to divergent
